segments.title: CHAPTER XVIII Inside the Other House

scenes.visual_description: A damp, earthen basement in a 1930s stone house plunged in darkness. Rough-hewn stone walls glisten with moisture. A bizarre upper chamber in a 1930s house, crowded with taxidermy. Wooden pedestals hold stuffed eagles, vultures, and owls with glassy eyes. Shadows stretch from the motionless birds.
